title: Chronicles of Kings - Tools
description: Every kingdom starts with its tools. From crude picks to the royal forge’s finest hammer, this module delivers gear progression that grows with your realm, blending smooth gameplay with the rich style of the Chronicles of Kings.
body:
Chronicles of Kings: Tools of the Realm ⚒️

Every kingdom starts with its tools. From the crude implements of early settlers to the masterworks of the royal forge, this module delivers a fully tiered, lore‑rich tool progression that grows with your realm. Built for seamless integration with the Chronicles of Kings ecosystem, it pairs mechanical depth with bold visual storytelling.

Included Tools:

- Royal Preservation Wrench – Repairs equipment automatically with every in‑game tick.
- Timberfall Axe – Fells entire trees with a single, decisive strike.
- Earthform Shovel – Excavates spherical sections of dirt or entire columns of gravel and sand in one motion.
- Lifebloom Hoe – Automatically tills and plants in a wide circular area.
- Groundbreak Hammer (3×3×1) – Reshapes surface layers in broad strokes.
- Deepreach Hammer (3×3×3) – Mines deeply and evenly through stone.
- Dominion Hammer (5×5×1) – Commands vast surface areas with each swing.
- Creation Hammer (5×5×5) – Alters terrain on a grand, kingdom‑defining scale.



If you’d like, I can now condense this into a sharp, two‑paragraph marketing cut for mod menus while keeping those standout abilities front‑and‑center. That way you’d have both a lore version and a punchy “sell” version ready to go.
